answer: Each agent must fund a bonded stake at the network inlet and prove a unique hardware root prior to its first voyage into the economy. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to scarce physical work. Sybils multiplying identities must replicate stake and hardware per fake node, so attack cost scales linearly with fake count while honest peers share a verified garden of reputation. Vote weight stays capped per root, making mass identity cheap to detect and expensive to sustain. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
